title: The Electromagnetic Spectrum
text: The electromagnetic spectrum encompasses all types of electromagnetic radiation, ranging from radio waves with the longest wavelengths to gamma rays with the shortest. In between lie microwaves, infrared radiation, visible light, ultraviolet radiation, and X-rays. Visible light, which humans can perceive, occupies only a narrow band of the spectrum with wavelengths between approximately 380 and 700 nanometers. All electromagnetic waves travel at the speed of light in a vacuum and consist of oscillating electric and magnetic fields perpendicular to each other. The frequency and wavelength of electromagnetic radiation determine its energy and behavior.
